t: You're looking at the Willis Building, a commercial skyscraper at 51 Lime Street in the City of London. It stands opposite the Lloyd's building and rises 125 metres, with a tiered, stepped profile. It was developed by British Land and completed in 2008. The architect is Norman Foster, widely recognised as a pioneer of high-tech architecture and a defining figure in British modernism, known for his structural steel and glass designs.
